component.name: Zalos
component.summary: Native Qt6 desktop client for Zalo on Linux

description.p: Zalos is a high-performance, native Linux messaging client for Zalo built with Qt6 (C++ and QML). It delivers an ultra-lean memory footprint (~50-90MB RAM), native Wayland and X11 support, adaptive GTK and Qt theming, and local End-to-End Encryption (E2EE) database synchronization.

ul.li: Native Wayland and Xorg dual-engine support with smooth Client-Side Decorations (CSD).
Adaptive Dark/Light theme following GNOME (Adwaita) and KDE (Breeze) desktop settings.
Native C++ cryptographic verification for E2EE message history (db-cross-v4).
StatusNotifierItem system tray integration with dynamic unread message badge count.
Low resource consumption: starts instantaneously with minimal CPU and RAM usage.

screenshot.caption: Zalos Main Window with Dark Mode and Wayland CSD

description.p: Initial release with pure Qt6 architecture, E2EE decryptor, and AppImage/RPM/Flatpak packaging.
